metadata.title: Gond Jewellery | Main Bhi Bharat | Tribal |  #adivasi #madhyapradesh #tribal
metadata.description: Gond is considered to be the largest tribal group in India. Women of this tribal group wear beautiful silver jewellery.

transcription_hindi: [00:00:02.179] गले में आपने पहना है इसको क्या बोलते हैं
[00:00:12.559] और पैरों वाले को क्या बोलते हैं थोड़ा सा इसको क्या बोलते हैं
transcription_english: [00:00:02.179] What you wear around your neck is what they call it.
[00:00:09.320] And what do they say to the leg-shaped little one?
[00:00:12.559] And what do they say to the leg-shaped thing, what do they say to a little bit of it?
